newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank faces 10 pct bad loans.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank faces 10 pct bad loans.

text.p: Thai Military Bank Plc said on Wednesday its non-performing loans stood at nine to 10 percent of its total lending at end-June.
Thai Military Bank president Somchart Intaratut gave no comparative figures for the past level of delinquent loans.

Thai Military Bank senior vice president Prakan Thavisuwan said he expected the bank to trim its non-performing loans to a lower level by end-1997, partly through improved debt collection and litigation against defaulting borrowers.
